name: znetwork_dplay_initialize_connection_from_provider_info
description: zNetworkDPlay::InitializeConnectionFromProviderInfo calls IDirectPlay4::InitializeConnection for the selected provider and normalizes success, user-cancel, and error-report results.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke uses the typed IDirectPlay4 vtable mirror slot at offset 0x98 to isolate InitializeConnection behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a140 validates the fastcall provider-info ABI, loading g_zNetwork_pDirectPlay4, passing providerInfo->connectionData with flags 0 to the DirectPlay vtable slot at offset 0x98, returning 1 for nonnegative HRESULTs, returning 0 for 0x88770118, and forwarding other failures to zNetwork_DPlay_ReportError at source line 0x7d.
The native smoke verifies success, 0x88770118, and generic DirectPlay failure paths, including the vtable call count, connection-data pointer, flags, and normalized return values.
